action.instructions: Which one action does the appliance take for the user's words? Each option is a whole action on what the appliance itself holds: what is playing, the music, the app, what it knows. Choose page when the words are about something on the page open. Choose none when the words are not a command.

options.play: music: find a song or video by the words and play it now, on YouTube or on this site as the words point — never the page's play button, which is a click
options.play_next: music: find a song by the words and play it after the one playing
options.queue: music: find a song by the words and add it to the end of the queue
options.say_time: appliance: say the time and date — 03:40, Saturday 24 October
options.say_weather: appliance: say today's weather in London, the home city — words naming another place or a website are a search, not this — London: 8°C, overcast now; today high 16°C, low 8°C, rain 100%; coming hours 04:00 8°C, 05:00 8°C, 06:00 8°C, 07:00 8°C, 08:00 8°C, 09:00 8°C; coming days 2026-10-25 13°C/9°C light drizzle, rain 92%, 2026-10-26 17°C/9°C drizzle, rain 92%, 2026-10-27 16°C/11°C drizzle, rain 41%
options.say_playing: appliance: say the song playing — nothing playing
options.say_timer: appliance: say how long is left on the timer — no timer set
options.timer: the app: set a timer for the length the words say
options.timer_off: the app: turn the timer off
options.flag: the app: mark the last thing it did as a failure, for its makers to look at — the words after it, if any, are the hint
options.help: the app: show and say what it can be asked to do
options.stop: stop what the app is doing: the page loading, the voice speaking
options.page: something on the page open, "Good Food | Recipes and cooking tips | Good Food": its links, buttons, fields or text
options.none: not a command: a remark, a question to no one, noise

slot.instructions: Which words of the transcript are the thing the command carries verbatim: the address to open, the search terms, the song to play, the text to type, the key to press? Never the command word itself: "play X" carries X. A line with no command word, such as a question, carries itself: its search terms are the line as asked. Choose none when it carries none.

options.none: the command carries no words of its own

where.instructions: Where do the words point: at something on this page, at something on bbcgoodfood.com that is not on this page, or somewhere else on the web?

options.page: on this page: one of the numbered refs
options.site: on bbcgoodfood.com but not on this page: a page, a person, a post, a section of it
options.web: elsewhere: another website, or a search of the whole web
